sloka: एवमादिश्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् ।मनसा पुष्पकं दध्यावागच्छेति महायशाः ।। ७.७५.५ ॥
transliteration: evamādiśya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṁ śubhalakṣaṇam ।manasā puṣpakaṁ dadhyāvāgaccheti mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.75.5 ॥

translations.english: Having thus instructed the auspicious-featured Lakshmana, the highly renowned Rama thought of the Pushpaka chariot in his mind, commanding it to come.
